prosody_instruction: Speak softly, as if thinking aloud to oneself rather than addressing anyone. Slow pace, drifting cadence, occasional trailing-off at clause ends. Avoid directive intonation. The tone should feel introspective, distracted, almost wandering — like someone remembering, imagining, or recounting to themselves rather than asking a listener for help.

chunks.text: I was remembering that Beijing trip back in 2025—everyone kept hyping up the food scene there.
And then later that year I was in Chengdu too, and people wouldn’t stop talking about what shows were going on in the city.
For dinner, my friend ended up booking Golden Dragon for us—two people—so I didn’t really do anything besides show up.
It was on 2025-03-27 at 19:00, and the reservation was under Zhou Jun; I remember because they double-checked the name.
After that, Zhang Wei grabbed us tickets for the Joker Xue Concert—2 seats in Stand A—and used 13845678901 for the purchase.
Oh, and for the restaurant booking they had Zhou Jun’s phone as 13867894321; plus I already settled that old bill BILL20260215004 a while ago, so it’s all done.
